'''Lot 452''' was a large parcel of land located on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. It has several large buildings surrounded by small hills. It was located several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside of a town, and had a private road leading off of the main highway.<ref name="H&S" />

==History==
Lot 452 was originally owned by a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Granz Niiliisi]]. It was taken over by [[ThunderForce]] who were hired by a competitor to remove Niiliisi. The local government decided they would not be able to remove the mercenary force and deeded the property to them in gratitude for removing the crime lord. The mercenary force upgraded the perimeter security with [[CovOps Mark III Surveillance Unit|surveillance pods]] and a fence. They installed multiple [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and anti-vehicle and anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="H&S" />
